{{Quote|The targets are a group of rebel Corellian officers. They already bombed Incorporation Spaceport and destroyed a squadron of Imperial transports.|Junia Tavrak|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Incorporation Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located in the [[Incorporation Islands]] district of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia's]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. It was heavily bombed during the [[Battle of Corellia]].
